column3: The ESA provided in connection with the Ahoskie Commons Mortgaged Property (0.3%) indicated that the Mortgaged Property has been impacted by an adjacent leaking underground storage tank (“LUST”) site and that up to nine monitoring wells are located onsite. The ESA identified the foregoing a REC, and recommended providing onsite access, as necessary, to the responsible party for the adjacent LUST case to pursue regulatory closure.
